__typename.description: GraphQL type name of this object.

isDisabled.description: Whether the store has been disabled, either by a user or as a result of a store merge.

logo.description: Returns the associated store logo, falling back to the global logo preference when the store has none. The logo is returned as a data URL schema, e.g. "data:image/png;base64,..." Lazy-loaded — the logo is not pulled with the default store row.
